Physician: Dr. [redacted name]

SPECIMEN TYPE: Peripheral blood
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Down syndrome suspected

PRIOR TESTING
Rapid PCR analysis for common aneuploidies previously performed (see separate report)

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested, and G-banded according to standard protocols. Twenty metaphase cells were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other significant numerical or structural abnormalities detected.

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. This result excludes trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) and other detectable numerical and major structural chromosome abnormalities at the resolution of this analysis.

LIMITATIONS
This test cannot detect balanced rearrangements that do not result in gain or loss of chromosomal material, low-level mosaicism (<10%), or submicroscopic deletions/duplications.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
